mapper.update: update biz_bed set status = '1', elder_id = #{elderId}, update_time = sysdate() where bed_id = #{bedId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and status = '0' and elder_id is null and del_flag = '0'
update biz_bed set status = '0', elder_id = null, update_time = sysdate() where elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select elder_id from biz_elder where id_card = #{idCard} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select elder_id from biz_elder where elder_name = #{elderName} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0' order by elder_id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update biz_elder set status = '0', care_level = #{checkin.careLevel}, checkin_date = #{checkin.checkinDate}, update_by = #{checkin.updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where elder_id = #{elderId} and del_flag = '0'
update biz_elder set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where elder_id = #{elderId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and del_flag = '0'
